purpose: Outer variadic evaluation warns on unknown missing CV before inner mapping. Unknown/duplicate mapping errors have only Closure::call, same-pack order fails before handler entry, inner count/type errors have internal Gen then outer Closure frames. <?php
function flow115A() { echo 'INIT|'; $value = yield 'head'; echo 'VALUE|', $value, '|'; yield 'tail'; }
function outer115A($error, $receiver) {
    $trace = $error->getTrace();
    echo $trace[0]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'call', '|', $trace[0]['args'][0] === $receiver, '|', !isset($trace[1]), '|';
}
$old = flow115A(); $receiver = flow115A(); $send = $old->send(...); $throw = $old->throw(...);
set_error_handler(function($level, $message) { echo 'WARN|', $message === 'Undefined variable $missing', '|'; return true; });
try { echo 'UNKNOWN|'; $send->call($receiver, extra: $missing); }
catch (Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage() === 'Unknown named parameter $extra', '|'; outer115A($error, $receiver); }
restore_error_handler();
try { echo 'COUNT|'; $send->call($receiver); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $error) { $trace = $error->getTrace(); echo $error->getMessage() === 'Generator::send() expects exactly 1 argument, 0 given', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'send', '|', !isset($trace[0]['file']), '|', !isset($trace[0]['line']), '|', $trace[0]['args'] === [], '|', $trace[1]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'call', '|', $trace[1]['file'] === __FILE__, '|', $trace[1]['args'][0] === $receiver, '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|'; }
try { echo 'NAME-POS|'; $send->call($receiver, ...['value' => 41], ...[42]); }
catch (Error $error) { $trace = $error->getTrace(); echo $error->getMessage() === 'Named parameter $value overwrites previous argument', '|', $trace[0]['args'][1] === 42, '|', $trace[0]['args']['value'] === 41, '|'; outer115A($error, $receiver); }
try { echo 'PACK-ORDER|'; $send->call($receiver, ...['value' => 41, 0 => 42]); }
catch (Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage() === 'Cannot use positional argument after named argument during unpacking', '|', $error->getTrace() === [], '|'; }
try { echo 'TYPE|'; $throw->call($receiver, exception: 17); }
catch (TypeError $error) { $trace = $error->getTrace(); echo $error->getMessage() === 'Generator::throw(): Argument #1 ($exception) must be of type Throwable, int given', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'throw', '|', !isset($trace[0]['file']), '|', !isset($trace[0]['line']), '|', $trace[0]['args'][0] === 17, '|', $trace[1]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'call', '|', $trace[1]['args'][0] === $receiver, '|', $trace[1]['args']['exception'] === 17, '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|'; }
try { echo 'NULL|'; $send->call(null, value: 41); }
catch (TypeError $error) { $trace = $error->getTrace(); echo $error->getMessage() === 'Closure::call(): Argument #1 ($newThis) must be of type object, null given', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Closure', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'call', '|', !isset($trace[1]), '|'; }
unset($error, $trace);
$method = 'call'; echo 'VALID|', $send->{$method}(value: 41, newThis: $old), '|DONE|';

purpose: Used and ignored native current results both retain the inner copy through newThis argv retirement. Unused payload frees before original capture, while used payload escapes after both Generators and capture retire.

<?php
class Payload115D {
    function __destruct() { global $wc, $wo, $wn; echo 'PAYLOAD|', $wn->get() === null, '|', $wc->get() === null, '|', $wo->get() === null, '|'; }
}
function old115D() { try { echo 'OLD-INIT|'; yield 'old'; } finally { global $wc, $wo; echo 'OLD-FIN|', $wc->get() === null, '|', $wo->get() !== null, '|'; } }
function fresh115D() { try { echo 'NEW-INIT|'; yield new Payload115D; } finally { global $wc, $wo, $wn; echo 'NEW-FIN|', $wc->get() !== null, '|', $wo->get() !== null, '|', $wn->get() !== null, '|'; } }
function receiver115D() { global $cap, $new, $wc, $wo, $wn; $result = $new; $cap = null; $new = null; echo 'HELD|', $wc->get() !== null, '|', $wo->get() !== null, '|', $wn->get() !== null, '|'; return $result; }
function run115D($used) {
    global $cap, $new, $wc, $wo, $wn;
    $old = old115D(); $old->current(); $cap = $old->current(...); $new = fresh115D();
    $wc = WeakReference::create($cap); $wo = WeakReference::create($old); $wn = WeakReference::create($new); $old = null;
    echo $used ? 'USED|' : 'UNUSED|';
    if ($used) { $held = $cap->call(receiver115D()); echo 'RETURN|', $held instanceof Payload115D, '|', $wc->get() === null, '|', $wo->get() === null, '|', $wn->get() === null, '|'; unset($held); }
    else { $cap->call(receiver115D()); echo 'RETURN|', $wc->get() === null, '|', $wo->get() === null, '|', $wn->get() === null, '|'; }
}
run115D(false); run115D(true); echo 'DONE|';

purpose: Outer argument destructor runs after replacement Generator retirement while original capture/oldGen remain live, throws supplied Stop with caller-only trace, and used uncommitted owning return outlives original capture/oldGen before catch.

<?php
class Stop115T extends Exception {}
class Return115T { function __destruct() { global $wc, $wo, $wn; echo 'RET|', $wn->get() === null, '|', $wc->get() === null, '|', $wo->get() === null, '|'; } }
class Argument115T {
    function __construct() { global $wa; $wa = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() {
        global $wc, $wo, $wn, $stop;
        echo 'ARG|', $wn->get() === null, '|', $wc->get() !== null, '|', $wo->get() !== null, '|';
        $probe = new Exception('arg'); $trace = $probe->getTrace();
        echo 'TRACE|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Argument115T', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === '__destruct', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'run115T', '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|';
        unset($trace, $probe); throw $stop;
    }
}
function old115T() { try { echo 'OLD-INIT|'; yield 'old'; } finally { global $wc, $wo; echo 'OLD-FIN|', $wc->get() === null, '|', $wo->get() !== null, '|'; } }
function fresh115T() {
    try { echo 'INIT|'; $received = yield 'head'; global $wa; echo 'VALUE|', $received === $wa->get(), '|'; unset($received); yield new Return115T; }
    finally { global $wc, $wo, $wn, $wa; echo 'NEW-FIN|', $wc->get() !== null, '|', $wo->get() !== null, '|', $wn->get() !== null, '|', $wa->get() !== null, '|'; }
}
function argument115T() { global $cap, $new, $wc, $wo, $wn; $cap = null; $new = null; echo 'HELD|', $wc->get() !== null, '|', $wo->get() !== null, '|', $wn->get() !== null, '|'; return new Argument115T; }
function run115T() { global $cap, $new; echo 'CALL|'; $result = $cap->call($new, argument115T()); echo 'BAD-RETURN|'; }
$stop = new Stop115T('given'); $old = old115T(); $old->current(); $cap = $old->send(...); $new = fresh115T();
$wc = WeakReference::create($cap); $wo = WeakReference::create($old); $wn = WeakReference::create($new); $old = null;
try { run115T(); echo 'BAD-CALLER|'; }
catch (Stop115T $caught) { echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|', $caught->getPrevious() === null, '|', $caught->getTrace() === [], '|', $wc->get() === null, '|', $wo->get() === null, '|', $wn->get() === null, '|', $wa->get() === null, '|'; }
echo 'DONE|';
